selected_direction: Recommend Separate Limited Real-Use Enablement Task
formula_branch: The next minimum gap is limited personal real-use authorization/runtime evidence, and the proposed minimum entry point does not trigger R-0040 because it remains CLI-only with Tauri/IPC disabled.
why_not_tauri_ipc_task: R-0040 remains Open / Conditional, but Tauri/IPC is not required for the smallest next CLI/local self-use slice. A Tauri/IPC task becomes necessary only if a future entry point uses those platform capabilities.
why_not_hold_for_smaller_gap: No smaller non-real product or evidence gap unlocks actual self-use. Permission, recovery, instructions and Gate 5 evidence all depend on first establishing a narrowly authorized real-use boundary.

recommended_task_boundary.purpose: Validate one narrow, reversible, local self-use capture-to-persistence-to-today-view slice.
must_name: new dedicated self-use directory and new local DB
first, repeat/idempotent, restart, failure and cleanup evidence
